description: Norcross also took the opportunity to talk about a bill he plans to introduce that he hopes will reduce fuel costs. The bill, the Camden Democrat explained, would lower gas taxes, discourage oil and gas companies from gouging consumers, and further empower the Federal Trade Commission to identify and punish those who do engage in price gouging while racking up record profits.
